Favourites, upsets and new champions

The favourite won 86 of 174 nights (49%). 28 different players have won, the newest first-time champion being Lito on 2026-10-19.

The favourite is whoever entered with the most titles here in the 12 months before that night. A tie makes each of them a favourite, so any of them winning counts. 6 nights had nobody entered with a title in the past 12 months and aren't counted. Matchup matrix (84 characters, every matchup in the data)

The whole dataset: every character that appears in a counted game, most played first, and every pair that met, however few games they have. Cell is the row character's winrate against the column character, games in brackets, from 4,364 games with both characters reported. Scroll sideways; the row character stays pinned. On a phone the one-character list reads easier. Small samples read with care: a cell can rest on a single game. Random Character is not in here: it's a random pick from the roster, not a character. Only games with both characters reported count; a game with just one side reported, or neither, is left out entirely. The same pairs are in data/matchups.json.
